title: Is a Growing Crystal Alive? Explained Simply | PUC Biology Class 11
description:
A sugar crystal hanging in syrup gets bigger every day, while a dry bean seed sits in a jar doing nothing for months. Diya asks the obvious question: which one is alive? Most people pick the crystal, and most people are wrong.

You will see the five features biologists check (growth, reproduction, metabolism, cellular organisation and response) and the test that makes a feature defining. A zoom ladder takes the bean seed down to its embryo, one cell and a mitochondrion, with every part labelled. The seed germinates stage by stage while the crystal only collects sugar on its outside. Then a side by side comparison, a pause and think check, a worked example (crystal, seed, candle flame, yeast), the exam trap about growth, an original NEET pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself. Note: this topic (What is living?) is from the older NCERT edition and is not in the current rationalised NCERT text.

This is Episode 2 of our PUC Biology series.
Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and NEET students.
